US Midterm Election Concerns Over Trump's Influence

Concerns are growing within the Republican party regarding the influence of President Donald Trump on the upcoming midterm elections. Factors contributing to this unease include the ongoing Iran war, rising prices, and the President's low approval ratings, which are seen as potentially benefiting the Democrats. Despite these challenges, Republicans have invested heavily in key races. The effectiveness of tax cuts, a signature achievement of the Trump administration, is also being questioned as its impact on healthcare and food assistance is reportedly affecting voters.
